content.brief: The Americans advanced via the south bridge before it was blown. Now the Germans must defend the town from their camp. Kill as many enemy soliders as possible in 15 minutes. The first team to reach 50 kills wins. Use the high ground in the church at the center of town to help you spot the enemy!
